tonight.headline: Nothing new since Friday: Likely is still the one question
body: Bad news first: Isaiah Likely is still your only tight end, and the last thing we know is that he did not practise Friday (groin). The Giants gave him no game status, Harbaugh calls it 'minor', and a Saturday-morning search found nothing newer. He starts. If he is inactive at 13:55 Sunday, add Chig Okonkwo (still a free agent, 52% owned) and drop Stefon Diggs.

Everything else held overnight. Tuten is off Jacksonville's final report after a limited Friday, and the lineup as set is the projection lineup. ESPN has you at 132.9 to 121.7 and 56%. One free move remains: put Tuten in FLEX and Gordon at RB before 12:00 Sunday.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Panda Attack start three Cowboys (Prescott, Javonte Williams, Pickens) at 12:00 against Tennessee, where Dallas' implied total is 31.0 (Rotowire TEN-DAL page), and Skattebo at 15:25 in the same game as your Tuten and Likely. A Dallas shootout plus a Likely zero is the losing script.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Likely inactive at 13:55 with no tight end added: about 13 projected points become zero. Tuten inactive would cost his RB slot unless he is in FLEX by 12:00.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Before Sun 12:00 CDMX, when Gordon and Warren lock
doFirst.title: Swap Gordon and Tuten's slots: Gordon at RB, Tuten at FLEX
doFirst.subtitle: Still not done (activity log, 12:50Z): free insurance. In FLEX, Waddle or Diggs could cover a surprise Tuten inactive at 13:55.

case.label: What you did
case.body: At 19:54Z Friday you put Gordon in and benched Diggs (activity log). That is the projection lineup, 137.1. Gordon went into FLEX, though, and Tuten is still in an RB slot (slot column, 12:50Z snapshot). No lineup move since.

case.label: Why it matters less now
case.body: Tuten went limited on Friday after a DNP Thursday, and Jacksonville gave him no game status on the joint final report (Giants.com 20 Nov 16:00). Rotowire lists him cleared. The risk is small, so this stays DEPTH.

case.label: Why it is still worth a minute
case.body: Every back you own locks at 12:00. Jacksonville's inactives come at 13:55. In FLEX, Tuten can be replaced by Waddle (DEN 15:25, off the report, PFT) or Diggs (Mon). In an RB slot he cannot. Points are the same either way.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tuten is active, so the swap changes nothing (no harm). It is WRONG only if Tuten is inactive and the slot scores zero because Tuten was still in an RB slot.
